title: ui_pass
summary: Benilla's ui_pass is a custom sorted-quad render substrate built because bevy_ui could not express the WoW (stratum, level, layer, sublayer, decl) total order. MSUI's UI is ImGui draw lists: painter's-order submission per window plus explicit panel ordering and WowSkin/GameplayArt texture draws achieve the same on-screen layering through a different substrate, and the gamma compositing question is handled by drawing straight into the gamma framebuffer.
